# Classic layout presentation provenance

This directory records the presentation-only Bootstrap 3.4.1 CSS rules used to
preserve the established PastureStack Server v1.6.358 Web Console layout.

- Visual authority: PastureStack Server `v1.6.358`
- Embedded Web Console: `1.6.56-pasturestack.36`
- Authority release artifact SHA-256: `bab18039ee378d9afc63421db33f52bc685ff993e0c5dbddd21b4526752347f1`
- Upstream presentation framework: Bootstrap `3.4.1`
- Upstream source: `https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v3.4.1`
- License: MIT, retained in `LICENSE.md`

Only the compiled presentation rules required by the existing application DOM
are retained in the light and dark theme Sass snapshots. Glyphicons, package
runtime code, jQuery plugins, and Bootstrap 3 JavaScript are not included.
Bootstrap `5.3.8` remains the maintained JavaScript interaction runtime.
